_source: Menghin, W. (2000) Der Berliner Goldhut und die goldenen Kalendarien der alteuropäischen Bronzezeit. Acta Praehistorica et Archaeologica 32, 31-108. Transcribed from the page images: assets/menghin/2000/jpg/menghin_page045.jpeg (Berlin, Abb. 14), menghin_page050.jpeg (Schifferstadt, Abb. 17), menghin_page053.jpeg (Avanton, Abb. 20), menghin_page061.jpeg (Ezelsdorf, Abb. 27).
_unit: A = Anzahl der Symbole (number of punched symbols in the zone, from the figure's right-hand 'A' column); K = Kreis-Anzahl im Symbol (concentric circles per symbol); SK = Summe der Kreise (sum of circles, = A x K). SK is Menghin's 'Zaehler' (day-counter) and is what the calendar arithmetic uses. This is NOT the same unit as Schmidt-Kaler's plain symbol counts (data/readings/schmidt_kaler.json).
_legend: The figures' legend reads: ○ Scheibensymbole (disc symbols); filled circle = Symbole in Schaltzonen (symbols in intercalary zones); △ Sondersymbole (special symbols, no ring value); small ring = Musterpunzen (pattern punches / fillers, not counted); Z = Zierzone; TB = Trennband.
_verified: Ring sums (SK) reproduced by scripts/verify_menghin2000.py and cross-checked against Menghin's own stated totals on pp. 76-91. Symbol counts (A) of the left-hand graphic column deviate from the right-hand A column in a few Ezelsdorf rows; the right-hand column is transcribed here because SK = A x K holds there for every row. See _open_questions.
_transcribed: 2026-10-12, from the page images (not from the OCR text layer)
_caveat: Menghin 2000's own summary symbol counts (474 / 432 / 505 / 462 for Ezelsdorf; 418 vs 399 for Berlin) do not all reproduce from these per-zone tables. The RING sums do reproduce exactly. Treat the ring/ SK data as verified, the symbol totals as flagged. Do not quote an A total without re-deriving it.
_open_questions: Berlin disc count: p. 81 states 418 Scheibenmotive (18 friezes, zones 3-4, 6-21); pp. 83 and 91 state 399 Buckelscheiben / Scheibensymbole for the same 1701 rings. The table sums to 418. Unresolved internal inconsistency.
Ezelsdorf: the graphic's left-hand 'A' column gives Z8 = 40 while the right-hand K/A/SK columns give 39 (SK 78). The text (p. 57) says 39. 39 is used here.
Ezelsdorf zones-3-to-21 symbol totals: table gives 508 'Zeichen' (432 + 22 + 21 + 33), Menghin states 505; table gives 465 disc symbols, Menghin states 462. Both off by 3.
Ezelsdorf zones-3-to-20 symbol totals: table gives 475 (432 + 22 + 21), Menghin states 474.

schifferstadt.sections: Spitze Z1-Z2 (Z1 undecorated), Schaft Z3-Z6, Kalotte Z7-Z9, Krempe Z10-Z11; Trennbaender TB1-TB4. Text (p. 49) groups the shaft including the plain apex as six zones (Z1-Z6) and the calotte as three.
schifferstadt.musterpunzen: 2 = plain boss Dm 8.0 mm; 3 = boss with one concentric circle Dm 12.0 mm (Z3, Z4); 4 = boss with one concentric circle Dm 14.0 mm (Z9); 5 = plain almond-shaped boss 12.0 x 0.5 mm (Z3, Z4); 6 = ring circle with central boss Dm 11.5 mm (Z10, Z11).

text calls Z3 and Z4 'Sonderzeichen' zones with plain almond-eye friezes; Abb. 17 marks both in the column for Musterpunze 5

published_totals.note: p. 76: 311 (six disc zones 2,5-9) + 44 (Sondermuster Z3+Z4) = 355; 355 + 202 (101 Krempe motifs x 2 rings) = 557 = the table's total SK. 266 is the plain symbol count of the eight disc zones (2, 5-11), not a ring sum.
